reviewType: AI-assisted heuristic review; not human review
method: Read completed raw cases, manifests and summaries; cross-check recorded real Java HTTP receipts against evaluation-time MySQL read-only snapshots. No new model/Runtime calls or independent live database re-query were made. Numeric SQL IDs and JSON string IDs are normalized to decimal strings for receipt comparisons.
scopeLimitations: Pre-approval zero writes is observed at the captured pre-decision checkpoint, not continuous monitoring.
Each case uses synthetic data and an isolated workspace; approval decisions are applied automatically by the test harness.
Rule failures remain failures regardless of the diagnostic classification.
Only one reservation was persisted; reservation parameter correctness cannot be generalized to absent drafts or all tasks.
Free-form semantic correctness remains unscored; selected factual/citation concerns are AI-assisted observations.
